tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Use when someone wants a list of local businesses in Central Austin, TX by kind (for example dentists, coffee shops, plumbers), optionally only ones with no website listed or with a phone or email. Returns name, category, address, website status and contact details, each linked to its source record.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: land_at, search_businesses · Public sink: search_businesses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: land_at, search_businesses · Public sink: search_businesses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
